_target_stimulus_sha256_note: When the annotation pass fills this artifact, set the top-level stimulus_sha256 field to this value to pin the labels to the post-C-8 stimulus JSON. _do_not_fabricate_labels: Per the §15.x §0.8 discipline, calibration labels MUST be produced by an actual Qwen-7B-in-K=6-chains run + human annotation. Do NOT placeholder-fill, do NOT generate from an LLM-judge, do NOT use synthetic labels. If labels are not available, leave the labels array empty and final_stimulus_sha remains null.
